<thought>Based on the molecular formula C₆H₁₀O₂, DBE = 2, three methyl groups, one carbonyl, and two sp² carbons, the structure corresponds to methyl 2‑methyl‑2‑propenoate (CC(C)=CC(=O)OC). The molecule can be conceptually split into an alkene fragment containing the two methyl groups and the double bond, and an ester fragment containing the carbonyl and methoxy group. Their SMILES strings are “CC(C)=C” and “C(=O)OC”.</thought>
<final_answer>['CC(C)=C', 'C(=O)OC']</final_answer>
